title: 3.6 Professions
unit_outcome: Use tightly supported exchanges to give a name and limited age/origin/job information and describe simple possession.
goal: Recognize six common professions and use the fixed job question-answer exchange.
grammar_function: I am a profession; He/She is a profession; What is your job? remains a fixed question chunk.
prerequisite: 3.3 be forms and 3.5 supported personal exchanges.
speaking_outcome: Repeat four profession statements and two complete job exchanges.
